profile.headline: Information Technology Professional
profile.geoLocationName: South Amboy, New Jersey, United States
profile.jobTitle: Lead Systems Engineer / Web Developer / IT Lead
profile.summary:
Systems engineer, web developer, and AI-assisted application builder with decades of hands-on experience designing, building, and supporting business-critical software systems from concept to production.
Strong background in web development, database design, automation, content management systems, API integrations, financial data tools, technical operations, and custom business applications. Experienced in working directly with management and business teams to define requirements, solve technical problems, improve workflows, and deliver practical systems that support real business needs.
Current work focuses on AI-enhanced business systems that connect content, data, search, classification, recommendations, automation, and decision support into usable applications.
Core technical background includes PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, MySQL, WordPress, APIs, XML, VBA, Swift, Java, C#, Visual Basic, PowerBuilder, SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, Microsoft Access, Bootstrap, React, and many related development tools.
Function before form: build the foundation, make the system work, then refine the interface.

positions.title: Lead Systems Engineer / Web Developer / IT Lead
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description: Multidisciplinary IT professional responsible for web development, backend programming, database work, API integrations, content management systems, financial data tools, automation, IT support and coordination, backend operations, technical troubleshooting, and production support across Capital Link’s digital properties and internal workflows.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · Graphic Design · Financial Reporting · Back-End Web Development · System Administration · WordPress · PHP · JavaScript · MySQL · Database Design · API Development · Data Integration · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Automation · Systems Engineering · Technical Leadership · Technical Support · Information Technology · Content Management Systems (CMS) · Business Process Automation · Software Architecture · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Analytics

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Focusing on client latest technologies of HTML, JavaScript, CSS, and on server-side frameworks (PHP,  MVC,.NET) used to deliver content and scripts to the client, and the interaction between server-side frameworks, the web server, and a database system. Content creator/copy writer, marketing advisor, user experience designer, web designer, web producer, project manager, software architect, or database administrator - including such tasks as web design and project management.

positions.title: Senior Lotus Notes Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for maintaining and developing new functionality for various Systems Applications.
•Worked in the maintenance and development of Lotus Notes Web Front End Applications with the 
ExtJS 4 Javascript framework (w/MVC), JSP, Java, REST, Hibernate, and MySQL as a back-end.

positions.title: Applications Support Analyst
positions.description:
Project manager responsible for the implementation and support of all outsourced Financial Applications in Latin America
•	Involved in the implementation of JDE E1 and Bottomline Transform for LATAM markets
•	Created hosted Citrix instances of all required finance applications for remote access
•	Integrated delivery centers to Instant messaging environment for seamless end user experience
•	Implemented a workflow solution to route invoices etc. for coding and approval
•	Provided imaging solution for large transaction volume markets
•	Successfully integrated a centralized help desk to provide technical support
•	Interacted with LATAM local IT groups to resolve programming/technical issues of Lotus Notes, MS Office, Oracle, AS400 and other platforms applications

positions.title: Professional Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop various websites for Commercial and Non-Profit institutions
•	Converted websites to full Content Management System
•	Developed and implemented interface, including header logo design and navigation
•	Developed and implemented SEO structure

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for maintaining and developing new functionality for Lotus Notes Applications, and Java Open       Systems Applications.
•	Supports existing Call Log, Trouble Tickets applications. Improved Learning Center application adding workflow and scheduling, developed Change Control workflow to improve reliability of Client Data.
•	Implemented specific Mailing functionality to advise Clients of New Product Releases available for download. 
•	Developed new Java functionality for existing multi-tiered application.

positions.title: Project Leader/Developer/Software Specialist
positions.description:
Responsible for the continuous implementation of new technologies to support the business model, dealing extensively with vendor, management and infrastructure representatives.
•Designed and implemented a customized CRM System, Lotus Notes Domino front-end, Oracle back-end via Java/JDBC and Websphere server-side reporting, saving the $4M cost of a CRM package.
•Successfully implemented design strategies to improve user interface and response time.
•Involved in the development of Departmental Website, Workflow and Reporting Compliance applications.
•Enhanced and optimized blast-email and call reporting functionalities. 
•Managed/ enhanced /optimized voting campaigns using Notes/Passthru HTML/Javascript/CGI Scripts. 
•Continuously supported adhoc user requests in Lotus Notes and MS-Office systems developing various complex Visual Basic macros.

positions.title: Lead Analyst
positions.description:
Responsible for the Development and Maintenance of new and enhanced functionality of major Lotus Notes distributed application.  
•Developed and implemented several LotusScript agents and functions.
•Implemented a series of Notrix jobs to provide heavy data transfer capabilities replacing existing PowerBuilder functionality. Process previously taking many hours improved to a few minutes.
•Developed a unique On-line data transfer capability using Sybase stored procedures and triggers to provide polling input to REXX processes which in turn execute Notrix jobs to update data in Notes.
•Successfully tested Web access to existing applications for future implementation.

positions.title: applications developer
positions.description: Programming, documenting, testing, and bug fixing involved in creating and maintaining applications.

positions.title: Information Systems Officer
positions.description:
Responsible for Lotus Notes Applications Development, Administration and Maintenance of several Lotus Notes applications (project tracking, workflow, broadcast, client tracking, and others), varying in size as well as complexity and distribution.  
•Automated financial updates from SQL DBMS.  
•Developed and implemented a sophisticated tickler system based on many-to-many relationships from multiple data sources. 
•Developed GUI Data Entry/Reporting front ends using ViP, PowerBuilder, VisualBasic.  
•Expedited Database distribution on global, divisional and departmental levels.  
•Facilitated the migration of Lotus Notes R3 to R4 applications. 
•Customized applications for Web access via Notes Domino Server.  
•Served as Notes Administrator installing, monitoring and troubleshooting Lotus Notes Servers.

positions.title: LAN Applications Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for the Analysis, Design and Implementation of Distributed Local Area Network Applications.
•Successfully developed Lotus Notes Applications in a Client/Server environment
•Consolidated multiple Legacy and PC Data sources.

positions.title: End User Support
positions.description: Programming, documenting, testing, and bug fixing involved in creating and maintaining applications.

positions.title: Applications Development Manager
positions.description:
Served as Project Leader with Applications Development Group .responsible for the analysis, design, implementation, documentation, training and maintenance of several automated systems varying in size as well as complexity. 
Applications Development Programmer/Analyst responsible for the development and implementation of several Applications Development projects. Administrative duties included project management, quality control, documentation and heavy user interface with all levels of management.
•Developed and successfully implemented a Detail General Ledger System, a Quarterly Management Reporting  System with integrated forecasting and graphics output, various Real Estate Financial Models, a Points Amortization System and many others; primarily hybrids of different programming languages
•Successfully completed the conversion of IBM mainframe applications to DEC 20 environment.  
•Developed and implemented Cobol applications in Wang VS 85.
